text:
anya: flagging an a11y regression I hit in the Models table (wide mode with column virtualization). Keyboard users can't reliably reach column headers to sort because headers get recycled off-DOM and focus jumps unpredictably. repro steps below. anya: repro (short): ``` 1) Console > Models > switch to Wide table view 2) Tab to table, try Shift+Tab to move to header cells and use Enter to sort 3) sometimes focus lands on the table body cell instead of the header or focus disappears when the header column is recycled ``` ben: thanks @anya. do we use role="grid"/role="columnheader" or a simple table? virtualization + native focus is always a pain. can you paste simplified markup? anya: simplified snippet: ```html
Name
Version
redwood-small
v1.2
``` chez: virtualization unmounting headers explains the jump. For grids we want a stable, focusable header container and use aria-activedescendant for header focus OR keep a single keyboard-accessible header element (tabindex=0) that lets arrow keys move across columns and triggers sorting. That avoids focus hitting removed nodes. daria: agree. NVDA reads columnheader only when it's focusable. aria-activedescendant on a single header container is good: set container role="row" tabindex="0" and swap aria-activedescendant to the visible column id. Screen readers keep focus on container and hear header labels as we change the active descendant. ben: small UX nuance: when using aria-activedescendant, we must ensure visual focus ring tracks the active column. We can set an aria-hidden pseudo-element on the active header or toggle a class on the mounted header and call scrollIntoView for columns that are offscreen. Also keyboard semantics: Left/Right to move columns, Enter or Space to sort, Shift+Enter for reverse. anya: I also noticed tooltips for header help icons ("sort info") are announced by VoiceOver inconsistently. We use title attributes on svg icons which VO sometimes ignores. Should make them accessible via aria-label and ensure tooltip text is exposed via aria-describedby when focused. chez: tooltip best practice: keep the icon a
Sort by model name. Press Enter to toggle asc/desc.
``` daria: also note the interaction with screen magnifiers: when we programmatically focus the container and change aria-activedescendant, call element.querySelector('#col-name').scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}) so the visual column is in viewport. That prevents keyboard users from losing context. anya: good point. One more nit: skiplink. Users had to tab many times to reach filters above the table. Can we add a skip-to-filters link at top of page (visually hidden but visible on focus) that points to #model-filters? Saves a lot for keyboard-only flows. chez: +1. Also ensure the skip link is first focusable element after body and has clear copy like "Skip to table filters". Useful for screen reader + keyboard combos. ben: tests: add an e2e that focuses header-row, sends Right Arrow x3 and asserts aria-activedescendant changes to the expected id and that the corresponding column cell gets a visible focus class. Add an axe check for tooltip role=tooltip and color-contrast for header focus ring. daria: visual patch for focus ring: ```css .header-active { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .skip-link:focus { position: absolute; top: 8px; left: 8px; background: var(--bg); padding: 8px; z-index: 9999; } ``` anya: I filed an issue with repro GIF and VoiceOver notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/5120. Marking P1 for accessibility regression. a11y-bot: checklist reminder: include VoiceOver + NVDA manual QA steps, update e2e and unit tests, and add release notes entry under "Accessibility fixes". deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for branch "fix/virtualized-table-header-a11y-5120" to staging in 20 minutes. chez: I'll draft a small PR that: (1) makes header-row tabindex=0 + aria-activedescendant, (2) wires left/right keyboard navigation and scrollIntoView, (3) converts help icons to button+aria-describedby tooltips, and (4) adds a skiplink to the top of the page. ben: happy to review and sign off on contrast tokens for the focus ring. anya: thanks folks 64f will QA after the canary lands and add VoiceOver test notes to the issue.
